blurb: Guests can dock boats of various sizes, rent kayaks and paddleboards, join guided kayak and paddleboard tours, take dolphin watching cruises, and book luxury yacht charters including sunset and fireworks cruises. Kayak tours include nature, fishing, and special event paddles. Dolphin tours range from small boat trips to large cruise ships with narrated experiences.
